ARRAY['selection_id'::text, 'kind'::text, 'source_id'::text, 'transport_mode'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb)) OR (((fo_price_origin ->> 'kind'::text) = 'site'::text) AND ((fo_price_origin - ARRAY['selection_id'::text, 'kind'::text, 'source_id'::text, 'transport_mode'::text, 'site'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb) AND ((fo_price_origin ->> 'source_id'::text) = (fo_price_origin ->> 'selection_id'::text)) AND (jsonb_typeof((fo_price_origin -> 'selection_id'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND ((fo_price_origin ->> 'selection_id'::text) ~ '^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((fo_price_origin -> 'site'::text)) = 'object'::text) AND ((fo_price_origin -> 'site'::text) ?& ARRAY['supplier'::text, 'offer_reference'::text, 'offer_date'::text, 'document'::text]) AND (((fo_price_origin -> 'site'::text) - ARRAY['supplier'::text, 'offer_reference'::text, 'offer_date'::text, 'document'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb) AND (jsonb_typeof((fo_price_origin #> '{site,supplier}'::text[])) = 'string'::text) AND ((fo_price_origin #>> '{site,supplier}'::text[]) ~ '^[^\x01-\x1f ]([^\x01-\x1f]{0,118}[^\x01-\x1f ])?$'::text) AND (((fo_price_origin #> '{site,offer_reference}'::text[]) = 'null'::jsonb) OR ((jsonb_typeof((fo_price_origin #> '{site,offer_reference}'::text[])) = 'string'::text) AND ((fo_price_origin #>> '{site,offer_reference}'::text[]) ~ '^[^\x01-\x1f ]([^\x01-\x1f]{0,118}[^\x01-\x1f ])?$'::text))) AND (jsonb_typeof((fo_price_origin #> '{site,offer_date}'::text[])) = 'string'::text) AND ((fo_price_origin #>> '{site,offer_date}'::text[]) ~ '^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])$'::text) AND (((fo_price_origin #> '{site,document}'::text[]) = 'null'::jsonb) OR ((jsonb_typeof((fo_price_origin #> '{site,document}'::text[])) = 'string'::text) AND ((fo_price_origin #>> '{site,document}'::text[]) ~ '^[^\x01-\x1f ]([^\x01-\x1f]{0,198}[^\x01-\x1f ])?$'::text)))))), false)))
